questions.question_text:
Complete the table of values for $y = 3x + 1$.
Which is the correct $y$-row?
$\begin{array}{c|cccc} x & 0 & 1 & 2 & 3 \\ \hline y & & & & \end{array}$

options.why: Left out the constant $+1$ and recorded $3x$ only.
Read $3x$ as $3 + x$, adding the coefficient instead of multiplying.
Added $1$ to each $x$ first, then tripled, evaluating $3(x + 1)$.

questions.question_text:
Complete the table of values for $y = 2x + 7$.
Which is the correct $y$-row?
$\begin{array}{c|cccc} x & -3 & -2 & -1 & 0 \\ \hline y & & & & \end{array}$

options.why: Ignored the negative signs on the $x$-values, substituting $3, 2, 1$.
Left out the constant $+7$ and recorded $2x$ only.
Negated the whole result, applying the sign to the $+7$ as well.

questions.question_text:
Complete the table of values for $y = -2x + 1$.
Which is the correct $y$-row?
$\begin{array}{c|cccc} x & 0 & 1 & 2 & 3 \\ \hline y & & & & \end{array}$

options.why: Ignored the negative sign on the coefficient, using $+2x$.
Negated the whole expression, changing the $+1$ to $-1$.
Read $-2x$ as $-2 + x$, adding $x$ instead of multiplying by $-2$.

questions.question_text:
Complete the table of values for $y = \frac{x}{2} + 1$.
Which is the correct $y$-row?
$\begin{array}{c|cccc} x & 0 & 2 & 4 & 6 \\ \hline y & & & & \end{array}$

options.why: Multiplied by $2$ instead of dividing by $2$.
Left out the constant $+1$ and recorded $\frac{x}{2}$ only.

questions.question_text:
Complete the table of values for $y = -3x - 2$.
Which is the correct $y$-row?
$\begin{array}{c|cccc} x & -2 & -1 & 1 & 2 \\ \hline y & & & & \end{array}$

options.why: Ignored the negative sign on the coefficient, using $+3x$.
Left out the constant $-2$ and recorded $-3x$ only.
Added the constant instead of subtracting, evaluating $-3x + 2$.

questions.question_text:
Complete the table of values for $y = \frac{x}{2} + 1$.
Which is the correct $y$-row?
$\begin{array}{c|cccc} x & -4 & -2 & 2 & 4 \\ \hline y & & & & \end{array}$

options.why: Multiplied by $2$ instead of dividing by $2$.
Left out the constant $+1$ and recorded $\frac{x}{2}$ only.

questions.question_text: Which is the correct table of values to plot $y=2x+3$?

options.why: Uses the rule $y=2x$ and omits the intercept three.
Does not substitute the listed negative and zero x-values correctly.
Uses a gradient of one instead of the given gradient two.

questions.solution_text: Evaluate $2x+3$: at $x=-2,-1,0,1,2$, the values are $-1,1,3,5,7$. This is table C.
